titre: La production de pétrole du Brésil bat record sur record
sous_titre: Moyenne journalière en millions de barils, moyennes annuelles 2024 et 2025 puis mois de 2026

2024.texte: 12.3% above that observed in 2024 (when it reached 3.358 million bbl/d)

2025.texte: 3.770 million barrels per day (bbl/d) were produced in 2025, a historical record

janvier 2026.texte: Regarding oil, 3.953 million barrels per day (bbl/d) were extracted, an increase of 14.6% compared to the same month in 2025

février 2026.texte: Regarding oil, 4.061 million barrels per day (bbl/d) were extracted, a positive variation of 2.7% compared to the previous month

mars 2026.texte: crude oil production hit 4.24 million barrels per day
